The '''Cave of Reflection''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located in the [[Nightmare Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Renik (Sith)|Renik]] discovered ancient tablets in the cave that allowed him to control the demented denizens of the Nightmare Lands, and he began gathering an army until [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kelthan]] dispatched [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces to stop him and recover the source of his power.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cave of Reflection appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where it is the site of the Republic mission "Darker Than Dark."<ref name="TOR" />
